# langchain-dexpaprika

> LangChain tools for the DexPaprika API: keyless DEX market data across every supported blockchain (33M+ tokens, 36M+ pools). No API key, no signup, no credential handling.

## Package

- PyPI: langchain-dexpaprika
- Import: langchain_dexpaprika
- Install: pip install -U langchain-dexpaprika
- Requires: Python >=3.10, langchain-core >=1.0

## Tools

- dexpaprika_search (DexPaprikaSearch): free-text search for tokens, pools, and DEXes; returns contract addresses and network ids for the other tools
- dexpaprika_token_details (DexPaprikaTokenDetails): price, FDV, liquidity, pool count, and 24h/6h/1h volume for one token on one network
- dexpaprika_token_pools (DexPaprikaTokenPools): pools where a token trades, sortable by volume, liquidity, transactions, age, or price change
- dexpaprika_pool_ohlcv (DexPaprikaPoolOHLCV): historical OHLCV candles for one pool, intervals 1m to 24h, up to 366 candles
- dexpaprika_networks (DexPaprikaNetworks): all supported networks with their exact ids and activity stats
- DexPaprikaToolkit: all five tools over one shared HTTP client

## Links

- API docs: https://docs.dexpaprika.com
- Agent integration guide: https://agents.dexpaprika.com
- Repository: https://github.com/coinpaprika/langchain-dexpaprika
